# Help exposes accepted values, defaults, and input forms.
exec card create --help
stdout '--type=TYPE'
stdout 'Issue type'
stdout 'Defaults to task'
stdout '--priority=PRIORITY'
stdout 'Defaults to 2'
stdout '--label=TERM'
stdout 'No prefix or \+ adds'
stdout '- is invalid'
! stdout '--add-label'
! stdout '--remove-label'

exec card list --help
stdout '--status=STATUS'
stdout 'Effective issue status to include: ready'
stdout 'blocked, in_progress, waiting, closed'
stdout 'or cancelled'
stdout '--under=ISSUE'
stdout '--assignee=ACTOR'
stdout '--label=TERM'
stdout 'No prefix or \+ requires'
stdout '--label-any=LABEL'
stdout 'Alternative label'
! stdout '--add-label'
! stdout '--remove-label'
stdout '--title=TEXT'
stdout '--priority-min=PRIORITY'
stdout 'Minimum inclusive priority from 0 through 4'
stdout '--priority-max=PRIORITY'
stdout 'Maximum inclusive priority from 0 through 4'
stdout '--sort=FIELD'
stdout '--limit=COUNT'

exec card claim --help
stdout '--label=TERM'
stdout 'or \+ requires; - excludes'
stdout '--label-any=LABEL'
stdout 'and requires'
stdout 'one --label-any match'
! stdout '--add-label'
! stdout '--remove-label'

exec card edit --help
stdout '--type=TYPE'
stdout '--priority=PRIORITY'
stdout '--summary=MARKDOWN'
stdout '--label=TERM'
stdout 'No prefix or \+ adds; - removes'
! stdout '--add-label'
! stdout '--remove-label'
stdout '--depends-on=TERM'
stdout 'No prefix or \+ adds; - removes'
stdout '--parent=ISSUE'
stdout 'Replacement containment parent issue ID'
stdout 'empty value to clear it'
! stdout '--clear-parent'
! stdout '--add-depends-on'
! stdout '--remove-depends-on'

exec card checkpoint approve --help
stdout 'Checkpoint to approve'
stdout 'Use - to read standard'
stdout 'input\.'

exec card checkpoint deny --help
stdout 'Checkpoint to deny'
stdout 'Use - to read standard'
stdout 'input\.'

exec card result set --help
stdout 'Use - or omit with piped input'

exec card state append --help
stdout 'Use - or omit with piped input'

exec card show --help
stdout '--context-depth=DEPTH'

exec card attachment list --help
stdout '--issue=ISSUE'
stdout '--limit=COUNT'
stdout '--after=TOKEN'
! stdout '--page-size'
! stdout '--page-token'

exec card config show --help
stdout '--scope=SCOPE'

exec card lease acquire --help
stdout '--ttl=DURATION'
stdout 'Positive lifetime in Go duration syntax'

exec card lease renew --help
stdout '--ttl=DURATION'
stdout 'Positive lifetime from renewal'

exec card lease revoke --help
stdout '--owner=ACTOR'
stdout '--reason=REASON'
stdout 'Expected active lease owner'
stdout 'Required operation context'
stdout 'does not establish external resource cleanup'
stdout 'returned reason and revocation context are transient'
stdout 'persist them as audit history'

exec git init -b main
exec card init --prefix correction-

# Removed attachment pagination spellings are rejected instead of aliased.
! exec card attachment list --page-size 1
stderr 'unknown flag --page-size'

! exec card attachment list --page-token opaque
stderr 'unknown flag --page-token'

# Ambiguous mailbox modes are usage errors.
! exec card mail recv --clear --peek
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/mail-clear-peek-error.txt

# Commands without structured output reject --json before doing work.
! exec card web --json
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/web-json-error.txt

# Ready and blocked reject zero instead of passing a hidden default downstream.
! exec card ready --limit 0
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/ready-limit-error.txt

! exec card blocked --limit 0
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/blocked-limit-error.txt

-- golden/mail-clear-peek-error.txt --
error: --clear cannot be combined with --peek, --all, --global, or --tail
-- golden/web-json-error.txt --
error: web: --json is not supported
-- golden/ready-limit-error.txt --
error: --limit must be positive
-- golden/blocked-limit-error.txt --
error: --limit must be positive
